lesson.summary: The run never reached what pull request #648 changed in merge-group: both jobs succeeded, so the time-limit steps, which run only when a job is cancelled, were skipped, and the jq time arithmetic is still unchecked in a real run.
lesson.detail: Pull request #648 replaced the `date -d` arithmetic in the "Tell whether this job stopped at its time limit" step of the begin and merge jobs with `jq ... fromdate`. That step runs only under `if: cancelled()`. Run 45054178991 was a workflow_dispatch run that ended in success, so GitHub skipped the step in both jobs and nothing ran the new line. Nothing went wrong and there is nothing to fix. The change will first be tested when a merge-group job is cancelled.
